name: Confusing Critical (Combat, Critical, Mythic)
body:
You can make your foes confused with a weapon blow at will.

Prerequisite(s): Confusing Critical, 3rd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): Once per round when you hit a foe with an attack, but the attack is not a critical, you may expend two uses of mythic power to inflict the effect of the Confusing Critical feat rather than your attack’s normal damage.

You may not add the effects of more than one mythic critical feat to a single attack.
